pageProps.title: Oppenheimer (2023)
pageProps.review: The film Oppenheimer is a masterpiece that excellently portrays the complex psychology of scientists agonizing over the power of nuclear explosions and historical moments through the overwhelming direction of a master.
pageProps.content:
## Review The word 'overwhelming' comes naturally, as you'd expect from a master's film. If you study a bit of background knowledge beforehand, you can feel the true value of the movie even more deeply.
It excellently expresses the agony and complex psychology of scientists who witnessed the power of nuclear explosions.
